## Wearer stats (EntadWearerStats.cs)
- Entad trait offsets on pawn stats (IsWearerStat categories) are added to the holder via a postfix on `StatWorker.StatOffsetFromGear`. `StatPart_Entad.TransformValue` skips those offsets when evaluating apparel/equipment, to avoid double counting when vanilla runs stat.parts over gear. Buildings (e.g. MeditationFocusStrength on furniture) still get offsets from the StatPart.
- "Relevant gear": `GearAffectsStat` only sees a ThingDef, so a [ThreadStatic] `explainingPawn` is set around `GetExplanationUnfinalized` (prefix + finalizer) and during each MoveNext of `GetInfoCardHyperlinks` (enumerator wrapper). An item counts as relevant if the pawn holds an item of that def with a non-zero *revealed* entad offset. Hidden-only items are not listed, but their effect still applies.
- `CompEntad.WearerOffset(stat, out hiddenPart)` caches the total and the unrevealed sum per stat. `InfoTextLineFromGear` shows the total minus the hidden part.

## Known open items
- The gear's own info-card equipped-offset row still includes hidden offsets in its Final value.
- PatchAll runs in the same static ctor as the StatPart injection; one failed runtime-target patch would skip injection.
- Hidden wearer-stat *factors* are not part of hiddenPart (rare: they need the stat in statBases).

## Dev tools
- "Add specific Entad trait" lists applicable traits first, then the rest, alphabetically within each group.
